A Canada visa photo checker has a built-in Canadian visa template. After you upload your photo, it analyses the biometric properties of your face, then crops and resizes the image to the required 35 x 45 mm frame. It centers your face, ensures enough space above the head, keeps the shoulders visible, and corrects the background to a plain white or light color. If you use a PhotoGov Canada visa photo checker, it also offers casual-to-formal clothes change and professional lighting correction. As a result, you receive a studio-grade visa photo with a higher chance of acceptance.<\/p>"},{"q":"Can I Use A Canada Visa Photo Tool for Free?","a":"

Yes, many websites offer a Canada visa photo tool for free, where you can create a compliant photo without paying. Typically, you can upload your picture, let the system crop and resize it to 35x45 mm, and then download the result. Some services may charge only for optional extras such as advanced retouching or printed delivery.<\/p>"},{"q":"What is the Benefit of an Online Canada Visa Photo Editor Compared to a Commercial Studio?","a":"

A reputable online Canada visa photo editor provides studio-grade results, but without travel costs or studio fees. You can retake and upload your photo as many times as needed until you are satisfied with your appearance and lighting. The tool also applies Canada-specific rules automatically, so you do not have to remember exact measurements and specifications.<\/p>"},{"q":"Can I Make a Canada Visa Photo Online from My Phone?","a":"

Yes, you can create a Canada visa photo online from your phone, using a web-based tool like PhotoGov. Take a clear picture in good, even lighting against a plain background, and upload it via your mobile browser. The service will crop and resize the image to 35 x 45 mm, adjust the framing, and give you downloadable files suitable for printing or online submission.<\/p>"},{"q":"How Should I Crop a Canada Visa Photo Correctly?","a":"

A correct Canada visa photo crop results in an image that is exactly 35 x 45 mm, with your head covering 70\u201380% of the frame. There should be a small amount of space above your head, and your eyes should sit roughly in the middle of the vertical axis, within the allowed range shown in official diagrams. The crop must include the top of your shoulders so that your full face and a portion of the upper body are visible. To avoid manual manipulations, crop your Canadian visa photo by uploading it to a free Canada visa photo tool \u2014\u00a0it will automatically adjust your original image to the current IRCC specs.<\/p>"},{"q":"How Do I Convert A Photo To Canada Visa Size for Free?","a":"

To convert a photo to Canada visa size for free, upload a clear portrait to an online Canada visa photo tool that follows IRCC photo rules and select \u201cCanada visa 35x45 mm\u201d as the target format. The service will automatically rescale the image, set the correct DPI, and narrow the frame so that your head falls within the required height range. After processing, you can download the final image and use it for printing or online submission.<\/p>"},{"q":"How Can I Edit Photo For Visa If I Do Not Have Photoshop?","a":"

Instead of Photoshop, you can use a browser-based Canada visa photo editor. It will crop the picture to the correct size, adjust the background, brightness, and contrast so your face is clearly visible. It will save you a lot of time compared to doing it in Photoshop.<\/p>"},{"q":"Is the IRCC Photo Editing Tool Free?","a":"

If you browse PhotoGov, it works as a free IRCC photo-editing tool. Upload a correctly taken selfie, and it will adjust it to match Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada visa photo rules. It uses IRCC guidelines for size, head position, and background, but runs independently from the Canadian government.<\/p>"},{"q":"Why Do I Need a Canada Visa Photo Checker?","a":"

To minimize the risk of your visa photo rejection. A Canada visa photo checker automatically verifies your photo against the biometric ICAO and the IRCC visa requirements \u2014 35 x 45 mm size, head height, crop, background color, and image clarity. It can warn you if your face is too small or too large, the background is not plain enough, or the lighting is uneven. A Canada visa photo validator often adds more detailed checks, such as eye level, distance to the top edge, and file size limits for online applications.<\/p>"},{"q":"What is an IRCC Photo?","a":"

An IRCC photo is any photograph submitted with an application to Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada, such as a visa, permit, or residence request. These photos must follow strict IRCC rules on size, head height, background, and recency. If your IRCC photo does not meet those standards, your application may be delayed or even rejected.<\/p>"},{"q":"How Do I Make a Canada Visa Photo Online For Electronic Submission?","a":"

To make a Canada visa photo online, first take a clear portrait against a plain light background, and upload it to a Canada visa photo tool. Select \u201cCanada visa,\u201d and the service will convert your image to the proper digital dimensions, file size, and biometric characteristics. As a result, you get a digital photo file that can be uploaded online with your visa application.<\/p>"},{"q":"How to Convert a Photo for a Visa Application?","a":"

If you already have a good portrait, the easiest way to convert a photo for a visa application is to use a dedicated Canada visa photo editor. Choose the country and document type \u2014\u00a0\u201cCanada visa,\u201d it will convert it to the correct size, proportions, adjusting the background colour, if needed. After that, you can print it out or upload the digital file with your online visa application, without manually editing measurements or head size.<\/p>"},{"q":"How to Make a Canada Visa Photo at Home?","a":"

Here is a little step-by-step guide to making your Canadian visa photo at home:<\/p>

Stand in front of a plain light wall, with even lighting and no harsh shadows on your face or background.<\/p>

Keep a neutral expression, look straight at the camera, and ensure your whole head and upper shoulders are visible.<\/p>

Take a few shots and choose the best image \u2014\u00a0sharp, properly lit, with your head and upper part of the shoulders square in the frame.<\/p>

Upload the picture to an online Canada visa photo editor. Choose \u201cCanada\u201d as your country and \u201cVisa\u201d as your document type.<\/p>

Wait until the service makes necessary adjustments to your original photo, resizing, cropping, and adjusting the background to the Canadian visa photo specs.<\/p>

Download the final visa photo in the required format. You\u2019re ready for submission!<\/p>"}]

schemaOrg: {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"How Can I Get a Canada Visa Photo Size Online Free?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"To get a Canada visa photo size online free, you can upload a regular portrait taken with your phone to a dedicated Canadian visa photo tool, like PhotoGov, and choose “Canada visa 35x45 mm” as the target format. The tool will automatically crop, center, and resize the image to the correct dimensions in millimeters and DPI. After that, you can download the ready file and either print it or use it for an online application."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What is a Canada Visa Photo Tool?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"A Canada visa photo tool is an online service or an app that automatically adjusts your picture to official Canadian visa photo standards. You upload your image, choose “Canada visa” as the document type, and the tool sets the canvas to 35x45 mm, adjusts head size, and aligns your eyes within the acceptable area. A reliable IRCC photo editing tool also prepares a printable and digital version of the photo."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How Does a Canada Visa Photo Checker Work?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"A Canada visa photo checker has a built-in Canadian visa template. After you upload your photo, it analyses the biometric properties of your face, then crops and resizes the image to the required 35 x 45 mm frame. It centers your face, ensures enough space above the head, keeps the shoulders visible, and corrects the background to a plain white or light color. If you use a PhotoGov Canada visa photo checker, it also offers casual-to-formal clothes change and professional lighting correction. As a result, you receive a studio-grade visa photo with a higher chance of acceptance."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Can I Use A Canada Visa Photo Tool for Free?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Yes, many websites offer a Canada visa photo tool for free, where you can create a compliant photo without paying. Typically, you can upload your picture, let the system crop and resize it to 35x45 mm, and then download the result. Some services may charge only for optional extras such as advanced retouching or printed delivery."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What is the Benefit of an Online Canada Visa Photo Editor Compared to a Commercial Studio?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"A reputable online Canada visa photo editor provides studio-grade results, but without travel costs or studio fees. You can retake and upload your photo as many times as needed until you are satisfied with your appearance and lighting. The tool also applies Canada-specific rules automatically, so you do not have to remember exact measurements and specifications."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Can I Make a Canada Visa Photo Online from My Phone?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Yes, you can create a Canada visa photo online from your phone, using a web-based tool like PhotoGov. Take a clear picture in good, even lighting against a plain background, and upload it via your mobile browser. The service will crop and resize the image to 35 x 45 mm, adjust the framing, and give you downloadable files suitable for printing or online submission."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How Should I Crop a Canada Visa Photo Correctly?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"A correct Canada visa photo crop results in an image that is exactly 35 x 45 mm, with your head covering 70–80% of the frame. There should be a small amount of space above your head, and your eyes should sit roughly in the middle of the vertical axis, within the allowed range shown in official diagrams. The crop must include the top of your shoulders so that your full face and a portion of the upper body are visible. To avoid manual manipulations, crop your Canadian visa photo by uploading it to a free Canada visa photo tool — it will automatically adjust your original image to the current IRCC specs."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How Do I Convert A Photo To Canada Visa Size for Free?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"To convert a photo to Canada visa size for free, upload a clear portrait to an online Canada visa photo tool that follows IRCC photo rules and select “Canada visa 35x45 mm” as the target format. The service will automatically rescale the image, set the correct DPI, and narrow the frame so that your head falls within the required height range. After processing, you can download the final image and use it for printing or online submission."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How Can I Edit Photo For Visa If I Do Not Have Photoshop?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Instead of Photoshop, you can use a browser-based Canada visa photo editor. It will crop the picture to the correct size, adjust the background, brightness, and contrast so your face is clearly visible. It will save you a lot of time compared to doing it in Photoshop."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Is the IRCC Photo Editing Tool Free?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"If you browse PhotoGov, it works as a free IRCC photo-editing tool. Upload a correctly taken selfie, and it will adjust it to match Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada visa photo rules. It uses IRCC guidelines for size, head position, and background, but runs independently from the Canadian government."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Why Do I Need a Canada Visa Photo Checker?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"To minimize the risk of your visa photo rejection. A Canada visa photo checker automatically verifies your photo against the biometric ICAO and the IRCC visa requirements — 35 x 45 mm size, head height, crop, background color, and image clarity. It can warn you if your face is too small or too large, the background is not plain enough, or the lighting is uneven. A Canada visa photo validator often adds more detailed checks, such as eye level, distance to the top edge, and file size limits for online applications."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What is an IRCC Photo?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"An IRCC photo is any photograph submitted with an application to Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada, such as a visa, permit, or residence request. These photos must follow strict IRCC rules on size, head height, background, and recency. If your IRCC photo does not meet those standards, your application may be delayed or even rejected."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How Do I Make a Canada Visa Photo Online For Electronic Submission?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"To make a Canada visa photo online, first take a clear portrait against a plain light background, and upload it to a Canada visa photo tool. Select “Canada visa,” and the service will convert your image to the proper digital dimensions, file size, and biometric characteristics. As a result, you get a digital photo file that can be uploaded online with your visa application."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How to Convert a Photo for a Visa Application?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"If you already have a good portrait, the easiest way to convert a photo for a visa application is to use a dedicated Canada visa photo editor. Choose the country and document type — “Canada visa,” it will convert it to the correct size, proportions, adjusting the background colour, if needed. After that, you can print it out or upload the digital file with your online visa application, without manually editing measurements or head size."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How to Make a Canada Visa Photo at Home?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Here is a little step-by-step guide to making your Canadian visa photo at home:Stand in front of a plain light wall, with even lighting and no harsh shadows on your face or background.Keep a neutral expression, look straight at the camera, and ensure your whole head and upper shoulders are visible.Take a few shots and choose the best image — sharp, properly lit, with your head and upper part of the shoulders square in the frame.Upload the picture to an online Canada visa photo editor. Choose “Canada” as your country and “Visa” as your document type.Wait until the service makes necessary adjustments to your original photo, resizing, cropping, and adjusting the background to the Canadian visa photo specs.Download the final visa photo in the required format. You’re ready for submission!"}}]}

children.innerHtml: What Is a Canadian Temporary Resident Visa (TRV)?

A temporary resident visa (TRV), also known as a visitor visa, is a legal document that allows eligible foreign nationals to enter Canada for short-term purposes like tourism, visiting family, business meetings, or short courses under six months. It comes in single-entry (one trip only) or multiple-entry (unlimited trips during validity) formats, typically lasting up to 10 years but permitting stays of no more than six months per visit, as decided by border officers.
TRV: Key Specifications
Issued to citizens of visa-required countries; exemptions apply for some nations via eTA (electronic travel authorization).
Requires proof of ties to the home country, sufficient funds, and intent to leave Canada after the visit.
Separate from work or study permits, which require additional applications.

children.innerHtml: Canada TRV Visa Photo Requirements

The Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC) sets the TRV photos requirements. The biometric information of the photos must adhere to the international standards of the International Civil Aviation Organisation (ICAO) Document 9303. Only photos that match these specifications exactly are accepted. The PhotoGov online service automatically matches your original photo to all IRCC photo specifications for temporary resident visa, listed below. IRCC applies different specifications to travel documents, and the rules for Canada passport photos are set out in their own guide.
Number of Photos
Provide two matching photos together with the completed application form.
Recency
The TRV photo must be taken within the last six months, accurately reflecting your current appearance
Photo Size

One of the key TRV photo specifications is the size of 35×45 mm (1.38×1.77 inches) with the head sized between 31 mm and 36 mm (1.22–1.42 inches). Photographs that do not meet these TRV photo requirements will not be accepted and must be retaken by the applicant.
Colour
Canada TRV photo must be taken in colour or in black-and-white. However, coloured photographs are preferable to help officials identify you.
Background

The picture should be taken against a neutral background, white or off‑white in color. This helps to ensure that the photograph is clear and that it stands out as it should, without any distractions. You should not digitally enhance your photograph; this includes adjusting the color balance.
Lighting
Even uniform lighting is required for Canadian temporary resident visa photos. The lighting must evenly show the applicant's facial features, skin tone, and hair color.
Positioning and Framing
Your TRV photo must display your full face, square to the camera, and centered within the frame. The top of your shoulders must also be visible in the shot.
Facial Expression
Keep a neutral expression and look directly into the camera — no smiles, frowns, or other expressions are acceptable. Keep your eyes open and your mouth closed.
Attire, Head Coverings, and Accessories

Dress in everyday clothing. Religious head coverings are permitted, provided they do not hide any part of your face or facial features. The same applies to headcovers used for medical reasons — in this case, an applicant must provide a signed medical certificate. No accessories or jewelry that obstruct facial features are allowed.
Glasses

Clear prescription eyeglasses are acceptable if they are medically necessary and your eyes remain fully visible behind the lenses. Tinted glasses, sunglasses, and frames that obscure the eyes are not permitted.
Digital Quality
A high-resolution digital photo is required when you apply online for your temporary resident visa. The acceptable resolution is 600 DPI. The file size — from 240 kB to 4 MB.
Print Quality
For a paper application, your TRV photos should be professionally printed on photo paper, either matte or glossy.

Where to Get a Canadian TRV Photo
Drug Stores and Pharmacies

Major Canadian pharmacy chains such as Shoppers Drug Mart, Rexall, and Jean Coutu offer in‑store photo services suitable for Canadian Temporary Resident Permit photos. Prices typically range from about 12–20 CAD depending on the location and number of prints.
Shipping Centres

Many UPS Store locations in Canada provide ID photo services that can be used for TRP applications. FedEx Office is less common in Canada than in the U.S., but selected printing and shipping centres may still offer compliant ID photo services; always check availability and price in advance.
Retail Stores

Some large retail chains and big‑box stores with photo centres, such as Walmart, also produce photos that meet Canadian immigration and visa requirements. Availability and pricing may vary by province, but you can generally expect a budget‑friendly option with basic compliance checks.
Professional Photographers

Independent photo studios and professional portrait photographers in Canada often offer dedicated services for immigration and visa photos, including Canadian TRV photo specifications. They usually charge more than pharmacies or retail chains but provide tailored lighting, posing guidance, and manual compliance checks, which can increase the likelihood of approval on the first try.
Online Passport Photo Maker

If you prefer not to visit a store, you can use an online passport photo maker, such as PhotoGov, that supports Canadian document standards, including temporary resident permit photos. The service allows you to upload a selfie from home, automatically crop and adjust it to the IRCC photo specifications for a temporary resident visa, and download a digital file or printable template ready for submission.

children.innerHtml: How to Take a Temporary Resident Visa Photo at Home

You can take a compliant Canadian temporary resident visa photo at home using just your smartphone or laptop, along with a simple setup in a well-lit room. Follow these expert tips to capture the image, and our service will adjust it to the IRCC requirements.
Find a spot with soft, even light (for example, next to a window) and stand against a plain white or very light wall so that there are no patterns or distractions behind you.
Place the camera at eye level, roughly at arm’s length, and secure it on a tripod, shelf, or stack of books so it does not move while you are posing.
Sit or stand upright, look straight into the lens, keep a neutral expression with your mouth closed, and remove anything that may create shadows on your face or hide your features.
Take several shots using the rear camera or a timer and select the sharpest photo where your face is centered and evenly lit.
Go to PhotoGov, choose Canadian TRV as your document type, and upload this image from your phone or computer.

Wait about 30 seconds. The system will automatically crop and adjust it to the required 35 × 45 mm format, check key technical parameters, and generate a ready‑to‑use file for printing or online submission.
Key Advantages of Our TRV Photo Maker

children.innerHtml: Applying for a Temporary Resident Visa

To apply for a Temporary Resident Visa (visitor visa), start by gathering proof of financial support that clearly demonstrates you can cover all expenses during your stay in Canada. You should also prepare information about your family members and your current legal status, and confirm whether anyone already holds permanent resident status in Canada, as this may affect which supporting documents are required in your application process. Permanent residence uses its own photo standard, described on the page covering PR card photo requirements.

Next, download and fill out the application form, making sure every field is properly completed, and the form is signed and dated. After that, book an appointment at the nearest visa application centre, where you will submit your valid passport, provide biometrics, and hand in your full visa application package.

Your package should include the following documents: a birth certificate, a passport, an original letter from an employer, a marriage certificate, or a statutory declaration for a common law partner or common law relationship, plus other additional documents confirming a change of name or marital status.

Use the official document checklist provided by Citizenship Canada to verify that you have included all required forms and supporting documents, and add any other official documents that help explain your situation and support your reasons for travelling to Canada as a temporary resident. Applicants who go on to apply for citizenship should read the Canada citizenship application photo requirements guide, because that document has its own rules.
Frequently Asked Questions

The photo must be 35×45 mm (1.38×1.77 inches), with the head measuring between 31–36 mm (1.22–1.42 inches).

"},{"q":"Can I Wear Glasses in My TRV Photo?","a":"

Yes. You may wear non‑tinted prescription glasses as long as your eyes are clearly visible. Sunglasses are not acceptable.

"},{"q":"Can I Smile in My Canadian TRV Photo?","a":"

No. Keep your face neutral and straight forward toward the camera. Your picture will be rejected even for a small tilt or grin.

"},{"q":"How Recent must my Temporary Resident Visa Photo Be?","a":"

The photographs must be taken within the last six months to accurately reflect your current appearance.

"},{"q":"Do I Need to Print a Photo for the Canadian Temporary Resident Permit?","a":"

Should you already have a digital photo for your Canadian Temporary Resident Permit, standard printer paper will not be enough for printing it. Either matte or glossy photo paper should be used for high-quality printing of the picture. You may visit any neighborhood photo business to reach this. Use appropriate paper and printing settings to make sure the print satisfies official criteria for your application.

"},{"q":"What Are Typical Mistakes to Avoid on TRV Photos?","a":"

Incorrect size:

Double‑check the photo's proportions — 35x45 mm with the head sized 31-36 mm. The wrong photo size is the most common rejection reason.

Expression or head tilt:

Keep your face neutral and straight forward toward the camera. Your picture will be rejected even for a small tilt or grin.

Lighting:

Dark or overexposed images aren't accepted.

Other official documents:

Refer to your document checklist to ensure that your application form is accepted.

You may wear non‑tinted prescription glasses as long as your eyes are clearly visible. Sunglasses are not acceptable."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Can I Smile in My Canadian TRV Photo?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"No. Keep your face neutral and straight forward toward the camera. Your picture will be rejected even for a small tilt or grin."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How Recent must my Temporary Resident Visa Photo Be?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"The photographs must be taken within the last six months to accurately reflect your current appearance."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Do I Need to Print a Photo for the Canadian Temporary Resident Permit?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Should you already have a digital photo for your Canadian Temporary Resident Permit, standard printer paper will not be enough for printing it. Either matte or glossy photo paper should be used for high-quality printing of the picture. You may visit any neighborhood photo business to reach this. Use appropriate paper and printing settings to make sure the print satisfies official criteria for your application."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What Are Typical Mistakes to Avoid on TRV Photos?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Incorrect size: Double‑check the photo's proportions — 35x45 mm with the head sized 31-36 mm. The wrong photo size is the most common rejection reason.Expression or head tilt: Keep your face neutral and straight forward toward the camera. Your picture will be rejected even for a small tilt or grin.Lighting: Dark or overexposed images aren't accepted.Other official documents: Refer to your document checklist to ensure that your application form is accepted."}}]}

children.innerHtml: APEC Business Travel Card: Photo Requirements

The China APEC Business Travel Card photo requirements are defined by the Chinese authorities and are based on international biometric standards of the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) Document 9303. When you apply for a China‑issued ABTC, your photograph must fully comply with these guidelines. But worry not, our online photo-making tool automatically converts your original photo into a 100% compliant image that follows all requirements listed below.
Number of Photos
One digital photo is usually required for online submissions, but keep an additional printed image in case it’s requested by the issuing authority.
Recency
An ABTC photo must be taken within the last six months to accurately reflect the applicant’s current appearance.
Photo Size
A passport-size photo 300x400 pixels is required, with the head height taking up 70–80% of the image.​ With the resolution of 300 DPI, the photo size is 2.54 × 3.39 cm or 25.4 × 33.9 mm.
Color
Only color photographs are accepted for ABTC applications; black‑and‑white or heavily filtered photos are not permitted.
Background
The background must be plain white, uniform, and free of shadows, patterns, textures, and borders.
Lighting
The APEC card photo requires even, professional lighting that shows natural skin tones and hair color.
Positioning and Framing
The applicant must face the camera directly, with the head centered and the face and shoulders square to the lens. The full face must be visible from chin to crown.
Facial Expression
A neutral expression is required, with eyes open and mouth closed.
Attire, Head Coverings, and Accessories

Uniforms, camouflage patterns, or very light clothing that blends into the white background aren’t allowed. An applicant must wear darker, plain clothing that contrasts with the background. Head coverings are not allowed unless worn for religious or medical reasons.
Glasses

Glasses are generally discouraged; if worn, the frames must not cover the eyes, and the lenses must be free of glare, reflections, or tint. Sunglasses and colored lenses are not allowed in ABTC photos.
Print Quality
APEC card photos must be printed on high‑quality matte or glossy photo paper and submitted without creases, spots, ink marks, etc.
Digital Quality
The digital image must be a sharp, high‑resolution color photo in RGB, at least 300 DPI, saved as a high‑quality JPG/JPEG file with a size between 40 KB and 120 KB.

What is the APEC Business Travel Card?

The APEC Business Travel Card is a document issued to Chinese professionals and other eligible businessmen, frequently travelling in the APEC region.

Instead of applying for a new short‑term business visa before every trip, the ABTC holders use this card. It allows to go through dedicated fast‑track lanes at immigration and without the hassle of preparing paperwork for each visit.
Who's Eligible for the Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation Card
Business travelers who hold a valid passport from an APEC member economy, or permanent residents of Hong Kong SAR (valid Chinese passport, or Hong Kong citizens).
Professionals who make regular short‑term business trips within the APEC region.
Senior government officials and employers are actively involved in APEC‑related work.
ABTS Application Process

In China, the card is arranged through the employer, and the application has to include a recent colour photo on a plain white background, plus its digital version. It's important to prepare a compliant, biometric‑style photo in advance to avoid delays or rejections. Use our online photo-making tool to get an ABTC card photo in under 30 seconds.

children.innerHtml: How to Take an ABTC Photo at Home

Today, with convenient photo-making tools like PhotoGov, you can take a suitable picture at home with your smartphone. Simply upload it to our platform, and get a fully compliant China APEC Business Travel Card photo. Follow the steps below to click a portrait, and PhotoGov will handle all technical adjustments.
Lighting. Choose a bright place with soft, even light, ideally near a window. Ideally, if a background is plain, pattern and texture-free.
Posture and framing. Stand upright, face the camera directly, and keep your shoulders square to the camera. Keep a neutral expression, with your mouth closed and your eyes open.

Camera settings. Use the back camera and place the phone about 2 meters (around 6.5 feet) away, or use the front camera and hold it about 50 cm (around 20 inches) from your face. Turn off portrait mode, set the timer for 3 or 10 seconds, and take a few sharp photos.

Processing in PhotoGov. Upload the best shot to PhotoGov, select the China APEC Business Travel Card option, and let the tool automatically crop, resize, and adjust the background to meet the requirements.
Download. Your high‑quality APEC card image is ready. Download a digital file for online submission or a printable version if a printed photo is required.
PhotoGov: 100% Compliance With China’s ABTC Photo Standards

PhotoGov formats your portrait according to the official photo specifications for the China‑issued APEC Business Travel Card, following Chinese authorities’ requirements and biometric guidelines based on ICAO Doc 9303 principles. The system automatically adjusts the background, head position, and facial proportions, and applies the exact 25 × 34 mm / 300 × 400 px layout used for China APEC Business Travel Card photos, ensuring that every technical element — from the distance between key facial features to overall brightness and contrast — matches the standards used during ABTC photo checks.

For applicants who want an extra layer of assurance, PhotoGov offers Human Verification. Our dedicated compliance specialist manually reviews the image, checking alignment, lighting, head size, background uniformity, and biometric accuracy before approving the final file.

schemaOrg: {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"Can I Use a Selfie for my China APEC Business Travel Card photo?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"No. You cannot submit a casual selfie as your official China APEC Business Travel Card photo, even if it looks good on your phone.However, you can take a selfie at home and upload it to PhotoGov, which will convert it into a compliant, biometric photo by correcting the background, crop, size, and composition to meet China APEC Business Travel Card requirements.​"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Can I Smile on the APEC Business Travel Card China Photo?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"No. A neutral expression is required: keep your mouth closed, do not show teeth, and look straight at the camera with relaxed facial muscles.​"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How Recent Should My ABTC Photo Be?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Your photo should be taken within the last 6 months to accurately reflect your current appearance.​"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Is a Digital Photo Sufficient, or Do I Need a Printed Photo?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"You can use a digital photo for an online submission, but a printed photo may be required for an in-person application, so it’s better to have both. Upon checkout at PhotoGov, you can download a printable DPF file and a digital picture."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Will PhotoGov Adjust the Background on my ABTC photo?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Yes. PhotoGov automatically adjusts the background and fine‑tunes brightness, contrast, and framing to meet China APEC Business Travel Card photo requirements.​"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What Happens if My ABTC Picture Is Rejected?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"If your photo is rejected, you can retake the picture at PhotoGov. children.innerHtml: Chinese Passport Photo Requirements

Guidelines and size requirements for a China passport photo are determined by the Exit-Entry Administration of the Ministry of Public Security (MPS) of the People’s Republic of China and are based on the biometric photo rules of the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) Document 9303. To ensure your passport application is accepted, your photo must strictly meet these specifications. When you create your picture with the PhotoGov free photo maker, all the necessary standards are automatically applied.
Number of Photos
Usually, two printed photos are required for submissions.
Recency
Chinese passport photo must be taken within the last six months and clearly reflect the applicant's current appearance.
Photo Size

The photo must measure 33 x 48 mm (3.3 x 4.8 cm), with the head height (chin to crown) about 30.0–34.1 mm, face width 16.0–24.0 mm, distance between pupils 7.0–10.0 mm, the eye line positioned roughly 12.9–20.8 mm from the top edge for adults (12.9–24.8 mm for children), and the distance from the hairline to the top edge about 2.1–3.8 mm.
Color
The Chinese passport photo must be submitted in color only.
Background
A plain white, light grey, or light blue background is required for Chinese passport applications.
Lighting
Professional lighting is required. It must accurately reflect natural skin tones, hair color of the applicant, and be free of shadows, glare of bright spots on the face.
Positioning and Framing
The applicant must face the camera directly with their head and shoulders squared in the shot.
Facial Expression

Only natural facial expressions with eyes open and mouth closed are accepted in Chinese passport photos. Strong facial expressions such as smiling or frowning are not permitted, as they may delay processing or lead to the application being rejected.
Attire, Head Coverings, and Accessories

Dark-colored clothing is preferred, and blue or white clothing is not allowed. Applicants must not wear uniforms, head coverings, or visible accessories such as headscarves, earrings, necklaces, or other jewelry, and must not wear glasses. Head coverings are allowed only when required for medical, cultural, or religious reasons, and in such cases, they must not obscure any part of the face or create shadows.
Glasses

Glasses and colored lenses are not permitted in Chinese passport and visa photos. Glasses may only be worn for medical reasons if a relevant medical certificate of proof is provided together with an application form.
Print Quality
The printed photographs must be produced on quality photo paper and should have a clean, even surface without any marks, folds, scratches, or visible borders.
Digital Quality

The digital photograph should be saved in JPEG format and produced in 24‑bit RGB color mode. If digitized from a paper photo, the scanning resolution must be no lower than 300 DPI. The resulting file size should fall between 20 KB and 80 KB. Any digital retouching or modification of natural facial features — including moles, scars, or hair — is strictly prohibited.

Where Can I take Chinese Passport Photo?

You can take a Chinese passport photo at local photo studios, printing shops, or retail chains that offer ID photo services, as long as they follow the official 33 × 48 mm size and biometric rules. Many applicants also use online tools that create compliant images ready for printing or digital submission. PhotoGov provides a dedicated Chinese passport photo template that automatically applies the correct size, background, and framing, so you can create a compliant photo from home and then download it or print it in a nearby shop.

children.innerHtml: How to Take a Chinese Passport Photo at Home

Today, to obtain a Chinese visa or a passport photo, you don't need to rush to a professional photo shop. With the PhotoGov free online photo maker, you can easily take a portrait with your smartphone or laptop, upload it to our platform, and it will convert it into an official Chinese passport photo size 33 x 48 mm. Follow our advice on a simple setup that will allow you to take a good photograph.
Find a well-lit area with a plain background. Make sure that the lighting is natural and doesn't cast any shadows on your face or background.
Wear dark, collared clothes. White and blue clothing isn't acceptable on the passport or Chinese visa photo.
Stand or sit up straight. Use a tripod to take a selfie, or hold a phone at about 20 inches away from your face. Even better — ask someone to take the photo from a distance of 5 to 7 feet.
Use the PhotoGov photo-making tool to adjust your picture to the official Chinese authorities' requirements.
Download your finalized passport photo in a digital or printable format. It is ready for in-person or online submission.
Taking Chinese Passport Photos of Babies and Сhildren

Pretty much the same requirements and setup are valid for Chinese baby passport photos. Pick a moment and create a calm atmosphere, and you'll be able to capture a suitable picture of your child. And trust the rest to PhotoGov: after you upload your infant or child's photo to our platform, it will automatically convert it to all Ministry of Public Security specifications.
Setting
Uniform lighting from a natural source, plain background.
Position
A newborn may lie on a blanket; older children — sit or stand.
Expression
Neutral facial expression, no crying or laughing.
Frame
No toys, parents’ hands, or other objects in the frame.
Printing Passport and Visa Photos

One of the key benefits of using our 33mm x 48mm photo free online tool is that it provides a downloadable file in professional, printable quality. After you've downloaded your printouts from PhotoGov, you can easily print them on photographic matte or glossy paper at home. If you don't have a printer, seek printing services near you.
Government Photo Compliance Guaranteed

PhotoGov follows the official photo specifications set by the Exit and Entry Administration of China, as well as international biometric standards defined in ICAO Doc 9303. Our team regularly reviews these regulations, ensuring that the system’s templates and software parameters meet the most current Chinese passport photo requirements.

For Chinese passports, images are formatted to the official 33 × 48 mm size with the correct head proportions, facial positioning, and uniform background color. The editing process is limited to adjusting dimensions, cropping, and background tone while keeping every facial feature completely natural. The final image file is ready for digital upload or printing within seconds.

For added confidence, applicants can activate the Human Verification feature — a manual review by a trained specialist to confirm full compliance with the latest Chinese passport photo standards, minimizing the risk of rejection during submission.

children.innerHtml: China Resident ID Card - Free Maker

Applying for a China Resident ID Card—for both Chinese nationals and foreign residents—calls for presenting a compatible photo.  Successful submission depends on your photo meeting the requirements, which official size for the China Resident ID Card photo is 26x32 mm.   PhotoGov makes it simple to produce a compliant China Resident ID photo.  Upload a selfie or photo, and we will crop, resize, and enhance your image to fit the precise specifications whether for digital submission or physical print.
Auto-crop the photo to fit the China employment authorization size (free online tool)
Full document requirements for photos
How to get a photo - tutorial
Get photo for: China Resident ID card 26x32 mm
Best Practices for Your China Resident ID Card Picture
Lighting: Apply gentle, consistent illumination. Steer clear of direct sunshine and shadows
Stand against a basic white or light-colored wall. Our system will resolve any background problems
Keep your face centered and gazing straight at the camera. Make sure your head is upright, not slanted
Wear dark, solid hues. Steer clear of very reflective toppers that mix with the background and white
Step-by-Step Instructions for Making Your China Resident ID Card Photo
Choose the Document Type
From the PhotoGov.net selection, select "China Resident ID Card - 26x32 mm"
Snap Your Picture
Your digital camera or smartphone will do.  Stand 1.5–2 meters from a white or light-colored background.  Make sure the lighting is natural and pleasant
Send the Picture
Send the snapshot to PhotoGov.  Make sure your face is visible and neutral
Automatic Resize & Optimize
PhotoGov will crop the picture to the precise 26x32 millimeter size, change the backdrop, and improve contrast and lighting
Download and Send
Prepare your last photo for online submission or print it for in-person submission at the pertinent authorities
Requirements for China Resident ID card photos
Your photo has to satisfy both technical and appearance criteria if it is to be accepted for your China Resident ID Card application.

children.innerHtml: How to take your own China Resident ID card photo

If you don’t want to go through the trouble and expense of locating and hiring a professional photographer to take your picture, you can simply take your own from home. So long as you follow the below instructions carefully, you can capture the perfect employment authorization photo yourself:
1. Take a picture of yourself

Open up the PhotoGov.net photo service and take your picture. Make sure you’re not wearing any headcovers or glasses, do not wear a uniform, and keep your expression neutral. Ensure that the area is well-lit and that you are standing against a neutral background.

children.innerHtml: 3. Receive your Passport Photo
Finally, you can download your ID photo. These images can be printed off, or you can simply use them as digital photos.
Common Errors to Avoid
Choosing the incorrect size image, such passport size rather than 26x32 mm
Wearing accessories or glasses that hide your face
Relying on overexposed, grainy, low-resolution photographs
Background with textures, shadows, or patterns
Ignoring or turning the head
PhotoGov automatically finds and fixes these mistakes during processing.
Extra Advice on Compliance
Avoiding filters or programs changing face features means no retouching
Make sure the image is clear and free of blurring or pixelation
Your face should cover 70–80% of the height of the picture
Digital entries should be JPEG or PNG, with under 1 MB file size
Guidelines for Printing and Submission
Print your photo in the precise 26x32 mm size on high-quality matte or glossy photo paper
Upload your file to the appropriate diplomatic system or gateway for digital submission.  Make sure it satisfies the necessary file format and size
How to take China Resident ID card photos for babies and kids

When taking pictures of babies and children for employment authorization, many of the same rules apply; for example, they must still adhere to the dress code, and the photograph must be high-quality and well-lit. With that being said, the State Department is generally more forgiving when it comes to the neutral expression requirement.
If you are photographing a newborn:
Spread a white sheet out over the floor.
Place the baby down on the sheet and take their photograph against it.
For slightly older babies:
Prop them up in a child’s chair against a white sheet.
If they are still unable to hold up their head, prop it up for them using a hand behind the sheet. Ensure no one else is visible in the shot.
PhotoGov Features
Our online passport photo tool offers several features to help you create the perfect photo:
Crop

Our in-built cropping feature allows you to trim new employment authorization photos and ensure that they don’t have uneven edges. This allows you to neaten up your picture and ensure it’s the proper size for your employment authorization.
Resize

You can also resize your picture as needed through PhotoGov, meaning that the end result will be a perfectly proportioned image that will fit just right into your employment authorization. Additionally, you don’t need to worry about stretching or squishing the image and ruining the quality.
Background removal
If you can’t find a neutral background against which you can take a satisfactory picture, don’t worry; we have a background removal tool that can help you achieve the same results.
Auto-adjustment
With the click of a button, you can have our auto-adjustment tool immediately optimize your image to meet brightness, color, and contrast standards.
How can i convert my photo to employment authorization size?

While you can convert the size of pictures using a variety of methods, the best option is to use our employment authorization photo tool - PhotoGov. That way, you can rest assured you’ll have a high-quality, properly sized end product, one that isn’t distorted or blurred by stretching or compressing.
I already have a digital employment authorization photo. How do i print it?

If you have a digital photograph, unfortunately, you won’t just be able to print it out on printer paper. You specifically need a high-quality print on either matte or glossy photo paper. You can either achieve this by visiting any photo service or by using our tool to print your image off at home.
Where to get a employment authorization photo
Pharmacies and drug stores
Well-known medicinal retail brands, namely Walgreens, CVS, and Rite Aid, proffer immediate passport photo solutions in-store. Do anticipate a charge, with most services priced around the $15 mark.
Shipping centers

Shipping giants like UPS, FedEx, and adjacent shipping facilities also cater to passport photo needs, mirroring the services of typical drugstores. At a going rate of around $15, it stands as a worthy alternative if you're considering external providers for your passport imagery.
Post offices and other passport acceptance agents

It's customary for post offices and agencies of a similar function to be equipped for passport applications, which includes offering photographic sessions. Maintaining the price consistency as observed earlier, you can typically expect a fee around the $15 ballpark.
Retail stores

Retail venues frequently host areas meant for passport photo shoots, assuring quality pictures in line with norms. Even though each establishment might set its own rate, you can usually anticipate a decent pricing range.

children.innerHtml: Chinese Visa Photo Requirements

China visa photo specifications are defined by the Consular Department of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People’s Republic of China (MFA of China). These guidelines are based on the biometric standards of the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) published in the Document 9303. When you apply for a Chinese visa, your photograph must adhere to each and every one of these standards — and our China visa photo size online free tool applies them automatically. In under 30 seconds, you get a 100% compliant, application-ready photo that meets all requirements listed below.
Number of Photos
For most Chinese visa applications, one photo is required to be submitted with the online form, but some embassies and visa centers may ask you to bring two identical printed photos.
Recency
The China visa photo must be taken within the last six months to reflect the applicant's current appearance.
Photo Size

China visa photo size for paper applications is 33 × 48 mm, with the head height between about 28 mm and 33 mm, and at least 7 mm of space above the head. The corresponding digital photo size requirements are 354 × 472 to 420 × 560 pixels, with the face width 191–251 pixels and a minimum height of 256 pixels.
Color
Only colored photos are accepted with Chinese visa applications.
Background
Plain light-colored or white background, or free of shadows, patterns, textures, or frames, is required.
Lighting
Chinese visa photos require professional, even lighting that naturally reflects the applicant's skin tones and hair color. No over- or underexposure is allowed.
Positioning and Framing
The applicant must face the camera directly with the face and shoulders square in the frame.
Facial Expression
Keep a neutral expression with eyes open and mouth closed.
Attire, Head Coverings, and Accessories

Avoid camouflage, uniforms, or casual clothing in light colors. Choose darker colors that don't blend with the background. Head coverings are not allowed, unless worn for medical or religious reasons — and only if they don't obstruct the applicant's facial features.
Glasses

Eyeglasses are allowed, but only if the frames don't cover the eyes, keeping them fully visible, and there is no glare or flash reflections on the lenses. Tinted glasses, sunglasses, or colored lenses are not allowed.
Print Quality
Only high-quality photos printed on glossy or matte photographic paper are accepted. No frame, wrinkles, or color distortions are allowed.
Digital Quality
High-quality image in RGB 24-bit true color, high resolution of at least 300 DPI, saved as JPG, file size 40-120 kB are accepted.

Where to Take Chinese Visa Photo

A Chinese visa photo can be taken in many locations worldwide, but we recommend keeping in mind that a 33*48 photo (354x472 pixels) format is rather uncommon in most countries. If you are wondering where to take a Chinese visa photo near me, it is best to inquire about it in your local photo studio or use an online China visa photo tool like PhotoGov. It allows you to make a picture for your visa application online, download a digital copy, and print it at home or in a local photo shop.
Pharmacies and Retail Chains (e.g., Walgreens in the U.S.)

In some countries, large pharmacy and retail chains provide Chinese visa photo services. In the United States, for example, Walgreens Chinese visa photo is a popular option: Walgreens pharmacy takes and prints a 33x48 photo on the spot. Don't forget to inquire about the availability of this service, or use shops like Walgreens mainly as a convenient printing point for a ready‑made file.
Photo Booths

Self‑service photo booths are one of the quickest ways to get ID photos. They are often installed in subway stations, shopping centres, and near government offices. Most booths are set up for local passport sizes, so check on the screen whether they offer a Chinese visa 33 × 48 mm option. However, being one of the most convenient options, this is not the most reliable one — the quality of the final image may be inconsistent, so we recommend choosing a more reliable option.
Professional Photo Studios

Professional photo studios often offer a wider range of document photo formats, including Chinese visas. This option is usually the most reliable and includes a professional setting with correct lighting, background, and templates. When you contact a studio, simply mention that you need a Chinese visa photo and confirm that it can provide the required 48 × 33 mm format before you book your visit. Keep in mind that this is the most pricey option, and one photo can cost up to $70 or more.
Online China Visa Photo Editor PhotoGov

As we mentioned above, the 354x472 or 48×33 mm Chinese visa photo size is quite uncommon, so the most convenient way to get a compliant photo is to use the Online China visa photo editor PhotoGov. You simply upload a selfie, and the tool automatically applies Chinese visa requirements, setting the correct size, framing, background, and head position. In under 30 seconds, you download a 354x472 digital photo for online applications, or a 33x48 mm print‑ready file. Just print it on professional photo paper, and you're ready for submission.

children.innerHtml: Chinese Visa: Taking the Perfect Picture at Home

With a China visa photo editor like PhotoGov available at hand, you don't need to spend time and money on a professional studio visit. You can take a perfectly acceptable picture at home with your smartphone, upload it to our platform, and get a compliant China visa photo. Follow the instructions below, and we'll take care of the rest.

Lighting. Find a well‑lit spot, preferably with natural daylight or several soft light sources. Make sure the background is plain white by hanging a simple white sheet or standing against a clean white wall.
Camera settings. Use a modern smartphone or a high‑quality digital camera, making sure the image is sharp, well‑exposed, and not blurry.
Posture. Stand straight, look directly into the camera, and check that your shoulders are square in the shot. Do not move or tilt your head.
Taking a shot. Hold the camera at eye level, frame your head and upper shoulders in the center, and take several photos to choose the sharpest, most natural-looking one.
Processing in PhotoGov. Upload your best shot to PhotoGov, choose the Chinese visa option, and let the tool automatically crop, resize, and adjust the background to meet 33 × 48 mm requirements.
Download. Your high-quality image is ready. Download a digital file for online submissions or a printable PDF for in-person applications.

CVS Pharmacy is a popular option for people preparing official documents. The stores are widely available across the United States, and CVS passport photo services are a convenient option for getting a compliant passport image without booking a professional studio. Searching for “CVS passport photo near me” typically leads to the nearest store with a photo center, where the picture is taken and printed on site. However, this approach comes with several limitations:
1. CVS Passport Photo Hours

First, the process depends entirely on store schedules. CVS passport photo hours vary by location, which means planning around store availability and travel time. If you want to get your picture taken outside regular business hours, it’s simply not possible.
By contrast, an online photo tool is available 24/7. There are no travel time and costs, no additional service fees. The image is digital, compliant, accepted for official use, and absolutely free.
2. Passport Photo CVS Cost

The CVS passport photo cost in 2025 is around $16.99 for two printed copies, with an additional fee for a CVS passport photo digital copy. If you need multiple prints or formats, the total increases to over $20.

Our online passport photo maker, PhotoGov, offers the same compliant image for $5.90 only for a digital image — with the first photo free of charge, no CVS passport photo coupon required, and no surprise add-ons.
3. CVS Passport Photo Appointment

Appointments are another inconvenience. A CVS passport photo appointment isn’t mandatory, but many locations operate on a first-come, first-served basis, which means unpredictable CVS passport photo times. This often leads to queues and delays, especially in busy urban areas. An online photo generator eliminates this uncertainty — the process takes just a few minutes at home.

Another key difference is formatting. In a store, a CVS passport picture depends on the staff, lighting, and printing equipment. Results may vary from one location to another.

The online tool PhotoGov uses automated processing to produce the correct background, proportions, and dimensions of the photos, depending on the type of application document. Shadows and uneven light are among the most common reasons a digital photo fails automated checks, and the passport photo lighting requirements page explains why.

You can upload a headshot with a distorted background, of a different size than the required document, and our online photomaker will take care of the adjustments — it will remove the background, crop the photo to the required size, and automatically comply with the government authority’s standards of the issuing country. children.innerHtml: PhotoGov: CVS Passport Photo Compliance

PhotoGov formats CVS-compatible passport photos to meet the official U.S. Department of State rules for passport and visa images, including size, background, head position, and color settings required by authorities. The system automatically corrects sizing and framing, without altering facial features — so you can skip a visit to CVS, but get a 100% compliant photo online.

All technical settings follow biometric photo recommendations based on the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) framework. PhotoGov reviews publicly available guidance from both the Department of State and ICAO to keep its presets aligned with the latest standards.

For users who want extra assurance before printing or submitting their passport-size photos, PhotoGov offers an optional Human Verification service, where an experienced specialist double-checks the photo for framing, exposure, background uniformity, and facial visibility. This additional review helps reduce the risk of a photo being rejected and gives guidance on the improvements, if needed.
Frequently Asked Questions

attributes.model:
[{"q":"What is the CVS Passport Photo Cost?","a":"

The CVS passport photo price is around $16.99 for two printed passport photos. With digital copies, the cost increases to $20.98. Alternatively, use the PhotoGov passport photo maker that offers a fully compliant passport picture — first photo free, and the following ones $5.90 for a digital, and $9.90 for a printable file. The entire process takes place online, with no need for appointments or visits to the store.

"},{"q":"Where Can I Find CVS Passport Photo Near Me?","a":"

Searching for “CVS passport photo near me” usually means driving to the nearest pharmacy that has a photo center. If you have time, go for it. But you can also make a passport-sized photo from the comfort of your home. Use our free online photo tool, PhotoGov, from anywhere in the world and generate a compliant passport photo* in less than a minute. The first photo with sizing and cropping is free of charge; the others cost less than a cup of coffee.

"},{"q":"Does CVS Offer Passport Photos Online?","a":"

No. CVS does not provide online passport photo services. All photos must be taken in person at a CVS store with a photo center. There is no official option to upload an image or order a digital file through the CVS website. Our online photo maker, PhotoGov, fills this gap by offering a fully online passport photo tool, available at any time, free of charge for the first passport-size photo.

"},{"q":"Are CVS Passport Photos Valid For Official Documents?","a":"

Yes. CVS passport photos meet U.S. Department of State standards. Our free online photo maker, Photogov.net, applies the same technical and biometric requirements, including background, size, and positioning, ensuring that photos generated online are equally compliant and valid for official use.

"},{"q":"Can I Get A CVS Passport Photo Without Leaving Home?","a":"

Yes. In this case, you need to use our free online tool, as CVS passport photo services are in-store only. With PhotoGov, you complete the entire process online. There is no need to go anywhere, schedule an appointment, or pay for the photo.

"},{"q":"How Long Does it Take to Get a Passport Photo at CVS vs Online?","a":"

Our free online photo tool generates a ready-to-use passport photo in seconds. The digital image is available for immediate download. Getting a CVS passport photo at a pharmacy typically takes 20–30 minutes, including travel, waiting, and payment.

Is the Quality of an Online Passport Photo the Same as at CVS?

Yes. PhotoGov uses automated image processing to meet the same requirements as in-store services. The generated file includes proper background removal, size adjustment, and face positioning, ensuring the same level of compliance as CVS, with no cost.

"},{"q":"Does CVS Offer International Passport Photo Sizes?","a":"

CVS mainly focuses on U.S. passport photo formats. International sizes may not be supported at all locations. PhotoGov covers dozens of international formats, including the European Union, Canada, the UK, Australia, and Asia, and formats the photo automatically.

"},{"q":"What Documents Can I Use the Photo For?","a":"

Photos generated by PhotoGov can be used for U.S. passports, visas, green cards, residence permits, work permits, driver’s licenses, national ID cards, and other official identity documents. All files comply with government standards.

"},{"q":"What Happens if My CVS Passport Photo is Rejected?","a":"

CVS offers a refund in case of rejection, but you must keep your receipt and return to the store. PhotoGov online passport photo maker allows unlimited retakes. You can generate a new compliant photo online without the need to travel.

"},{"q":"Why Choose PhotoGov Instead of CVS Passport Photo Services?","a":"

PhotoGov is fully online, free for the first passport-size photo, and faster. CVS requires visiting a physical location, waiting in line, and paying for the service. Our free online photo maker provides the same compliance with lower effort and no cost for the first CVS passport photo, and if you need more, they will be less costly than a visit to the shop.

"},{"q":"CVS Passport Photo: Is It Better to Take In Person or Online?","a":"

Choosing between an in-store CVS passport photo and an online passport photo maker depends on how you prefer to manage the process. CVS offers a traditional, fixed-price service that requires visiting a physical location, with the cost reaching up to $20, depending on the selected options. PhotoGov provides the same compliant result entirely online, at no cost, and within minutes. The file can be downloaded instantly and used for official applications without scheduling, travel, or additional fees.

"}]

children.innerHtml: German Passport Photo Requirements

German passport photo requirements are defined by the Federal Foreign Office (Auswärtiges Amt), the Federal Ministry of the Interior and Community (Bundesministerium des Innern und für Heimat, BMI), and the authorities responsible for issuing the national identity card (Personalausweisportal / Bundesdruckerei). Their guidelines follow the biometric principles set out in the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) Document 9303, and these standards are reflected in the official photo examples published by the German authorities.

Meeting these requirements is essential for any German passport, visa, or residence application. The PhotoGov Germany photo edit tool prepares your portrait in the correct 35×45-mm format and applies the necessary background, proportions, and positioning. The final image follows the requirements below:
Number of Photos
Most German authorities request one biometric photo; certain applications may require two copies depending on the issuing office.
Recency
The visa, ID, or passport photo must be taken within the past six months and reflect the applicant’s current appearance without significant changes.
Photo Size
The standard passport photo size is 35×45 mm, with the head height set between 32 and 36 mm from chin to crown.
Color
Only color photographs are accepted for German passports and visas; black-and-white images do not meet the standard.
Background
The background must be uniform and light — white, off-white, or very light grey — without patterns, gradients, or visible shadows.
Lighting
Soft, even lighting is required to preserve natural skin tone and prevent shadows or glare on the face or background.
Positioning and Framing
The face centered and directed straight toward the camera, fully visible, with level shoulders and no decorative borders.
Facial Expression
A neutral expression is required, with eyes open and mouth closed; smiling or exaggerated expressions fall outside the biometric rules.
Attire, Head Coverings, and Accessories

Outfit options are limited to everyday clothing, in colors contrasting with the light background, and free of large logos. No military wear or camouflage is allowed on ID pictures. Head coverings are accepted only for continuous medical or religious purposes and must leave the full face visible.
Glasses
Clear-lens glasses are allowed as long as the eyes remain fully visible and free of glare or flash reflections. Tinted lenses and sunglasses are not permitted.
Print and Digital Quality

The photo must be sharp and well-exposed. Digital submissions typically require at least 300 DPI digital file and must fall within the size limits set by German authorities; a printable image must be produced on a color printer and high-quality matte or glossy photo paper.

You can take a German ID or a passport photo in a wide range of everyday locations — from automated kiosks to professional studios. Each option has its pros and cons. Let's explore them in more detail.
Pharmacies and Drugstores

Major German retailers such as dm, Müller, and Rossmann provide on-site biometric photo services. Their terminals and staffed counters produce images that adhere to the German 35×45-mm biometric standard used for ID, visa, and passport pictures.
Deutsche Post Branches

Many Deutsche Post offices allow customers to print ID-compliant photos directly in the branch. For applicants who already plan to visit for mailing or application purposes, this can be a practical two-in-one stop.
Self-Service Photo Stations

Automated booths like FotoFix, PhotoMe, and CEWE are widespread in Germany. They are typically found in train stations, shopping centres, and larger supermarkets, and can produce biometric prints in the correct size within minutes.
Professional Photo Studios

A professional photographer or a studio is the most reliable way to get your German visa, ID, or passport photo. Proper setup, lighting, and adherence to the biometric ICAO standards — are the high standard of this in-person service. However, it requires time, a possible advance appointment, and the service can be quite pricey, up to €35.

With digital services like PhotoGov, you can create a German passport photo size 35×45-mm online without leaving your home. The system applies the official 35×45-mm layout to your portrait: the correct size, head positioning, and framing. Our German passport photo size online free tool works as a background remover, in case your original photo doesn't meet the biometric requirements. In under 30 seconds, you receive a digital image or a PDF crop page ready to be printed at home or with print service providers. The best thing? In many countries, the first image is free, allowing you to save money and making it an efficient alternative to an in-person visit.

children.innerHtml: Taking Your Germany Passport Photo Size 35 x 45 mm at Home

Today, with a convenient Germany photo edit tool like PhotoGov, you don't really need to spend time and extra money on professional studio visits. Using just your smartphone or a digital camera, you can take an acceptable portrait — and our platform will turn it into an application-ready, biometric-compliant photograph that meets the BMI and ICAO standards.

Choose a spot with soft, natural light — standing near a window works well — and use a plain, light background without shadows or visual distractions. This setup helps keep facial details clear and evenly illuminated.
Position the phone at eye level, about 40–50 cm from the face, and avoid flash or portrait mode, as both can distort the lighting and depth of the image.
Look directly into the camera with a neutral expression and take several photos to ensure you capture a sharp picture without any shadows, glare, or reflections.

Once the picture is ready, upload it to PhotoGov Germany photo editor. Choose the country and the photo type, and the system formats the image to the official 35×45-mm layout, adjusting head proportions and background tone.
Choose a download page in the PDF format (a single sheet with four pictures) for the photo printer, or download a digital file for online application.
Print passport photo on a high-quality matte or semi-matte photo paper. You are ready to submit your ID, visa, or passport photo!
Taking a German Baby Passport Photo

German baby photo requirements follow the same standards used for adults, but the rules of acceptance are slightly less strict. Partially closed eyes or a naturally parted mouth are acceptable for infants. However, crying, laughing, or visible strain must be avoided. The baby needs to face the camera directly, and the facial features must be clearly visible. Follow these simple setup tips for a seamless home photo studio process, and our tool will convert the image into a proper ID or passport photo.
Setting
Uniform lighting from a natural source, plain background.
Position
A newborn may lie on a blanket; older children — sit or stand.
Expression
Neutral facial expression, no crying or laughing.
Frame
No toys, parents’ hands, or other objects in the frame.
PhotoGov: 100% Compliance With German Passport Photo Requirements

PhotoGov formats your portrait according to the specifications issued by the Federal Ministry of the Interior and Community, the Federal Foreign Office, and the biometric guidelines defined in ICAO Document 9303. The system calibrates background shade, adjusts head position and facial proportions, balances exposure, and applies the exact 35×45-mm layout used for German passports, visas, and identification document photographs. Every technical element — from the distance between facial landmarks to the brightness of the background — is aligned with the standards that German authorities use when reviewing ID photos.

For applicants who prefer a more thorough check, PhotoGov offers Human Verification. Our top compliance specialist examines the image manually, reviewing alignment, lighting, head size, background consistency, and biometric accuracy before the final file is released. This additional step gives users full confidence that their photo meets the requirements applied by German consular and passport offices.

children.innerHtml: Germany Visa Photo – 35x45 mm in 2025

Applying for a German visa? You’ll need a biometric photo that meets strict Schengen specifications — typically 35x45 mm (3.5x4.5 cm). A single error in size, background, or facial expression can delay your visa application. PhotoGov makes it simple: take a selfie on your phone and get a fully compliant Germany visa photo in just a few clicks. Ready for print or digital submission, guaranteed. The passport follows its own rules, set out in the German passport photo requirements 2026 guide.
Auto-crop the photo to fit the Germany visa size (free online tool)
Full document requirements for photos
How to get a photo - tutorial
Get photo for: Germany Visa 35x45 mm (3.5x4.5 cm)
How to Take a Visa Photo at Home
Lighting: Use natural or soft artificial light. Avoid shadows or direct sunlight.
Background: Stand against a plain white or very light wall.
Distance: Hold your phone or camera at eye level, about 1.5 m away.
Framing: Your face should occupy 70–80% of the image.
Posture: Sit or stand straight, keep a neutral expression.
With PhotoGov, even an ordinary selfie becomes an embassy-compliant biometric photo.
Steps to Create Your Germany Visa Photo
Use PhotoGov to generate your Germany visa photo at home — just follow these quick steps:
Select the Document Type.
Pick "Germany Visa – 35x45 mm" from the PhotoGov document list.
Capture the Photo.
Stand 1.5–2 meters from the camera. Use soft lighting and a light wall.
Upload Your Photo.
Submit your photo for analysis and automatic background check.
Optimize and Edit.
Our system will crop, resize, clean the background, and enhance sharpness.
Download and Submit/
Get digital and printable versions ready for visa submission.
*Data from government agencies
Appearance Requirements
Expression
Neutral – no smiling or frowning
Eyes
Fully open, directly facing the camera
Head position
Centered, straight, not tilted
Glasses, Head coverings
Glasses - Not allowed, Head coverings - Only for religious reasons – must not hide facial features
Clothing, Accessories
Dark or medium-tone clothing, no white tops. No hats, jewelry, or headphones
Lighting
Even and shadow-free across face and background

If you don’t want to go through the trouble and expense of locating and hiring a professional photographer to take your picture, you can simply take your own from home. So long as you follow the below instructions carefully, you can capture the perfect visa photo yourself:
1. Take a picture of yourself

Open up the PhotoGov.net photo service and take your picture. Make sure you’re not wearing any headcovers or glasses, do not wear a uniform, and keep your expression neutral. Ensure that the area is well-lit and that you are standing against a neutral background.

children.innerHtml: 3. Receive your Passport Photo
Finally, you can download your ID photo. These images can be printed off, or you can simply use them as digital photos.
Common Mistakes to Avoid
Using passport-size (wrong format) instead of 35x45 mm
Wearing white tops that blend into background
Smiling or frowning
Glasses, shadows, or poor focus
Cropping too tightly or uneven framing
PhotoGov instantly checks and corrects every photo before download.
Can i take my visa picture at home?
So long as you’re willing to put in the effort to take a good photograph, there’s nothing stopping you from taking your visa picture at home. Simply follow these steps:
Observe the proper dress code.
Ensure your area is well-lit.
Take the picture up against a neutral background.
How to take a Germany Visa photo using a phone
So long as your smartphone has a good quality camera, you can certainly use it to take a picture for your visa. With that being said, however, selfies are not acceptable, so follow these steps:
Ask someone to take your picture for you.
Position them 5-7 feet away so that only your upper body is in the shot.
Alternatively, use a tripod set up between 5-7 feet away. Move it as necessary to get the perfect picture.
How to take Germany Visa photos for babies and kids

When taking pictures of babies and children for visa, many of the same rules apply; for example, they must still adhere to the dress code, and the photograph must be high-quality and well-lit. With that being said, the State Department is generally more forgiving when it comes to the neutral expression requirement.
If you are photographing a newborn:
Spread a white sheet out over the floor.
Place the baby down on the sheet and take their photograph against it.
For slightly older babies:
Prop them up in a child’s chair against a white sheet.
If they are still unable to hold up their head, prop it up for them using a hand behind the sheet. Ensure no one else is visible in the shot.

Crop
Crops your image to exact 35x45 mm dimensions
Resize
Scales resolution and file size for embassy or digital upload
Background removal
Clean white or light-gray background applied automatically
Auto-adjustment
Enhances lighting, contrast, and alignment
How can i convert my photo to visa size?

While you can convert the size of pictures using a variety of methods, the best option is to use our visa photo tool - PhotoGov. That way, you can rest assured you’ll have a high-quality, properly sized end product, one that isn’t distorted or blurred by stretching or compressing.

No need for a camera or photo studio

In digital and print-ready formats
